bodies.name: Camera Deputaților (Chamber of Deputies)
bodies.layout: A legacy Oracle APEX (ORDS) application built on a URL scheme still exposing 'ords/pls' PL/SQL procedure calls, reflecting decades-old government IT infrastructure. The homepage stacks a masthead with the Chamber's coat-of-arms crest and social icons, a slim RO/EN/FR language switcher, and a sprawling multi-column flyout mega-menu ('Structuri parlamentare', 'Activitate parlamentară', 'Informaţii publice'). Below a rotating photo slider of the plenary hall sits a three-column 'Actualitate parlamentară / Resurse parlamentare / Anunţuri' block, a parliamentary-group membership grid with logos and seat counts, and a dense 'Ştiri' (News) river of press-release cards tied to individual deputies. The page closes with a legislative-resources block, a media gallery, and a footer linking to sister institutions (Senate, Presidency, Government, Constitutional Court).
ui_patterns: legacy PL/SQL / Oracle APEX URL structure (ords/pls/...) exposed directly in menu links
parliamentary-group grid showing party logos with live seat counts (e.g. '91 Membri')
individual deputy press-release cards with headshot thumbnails ('Comunicat de presa')
alphabetical deputy directory paginated by first letter of surname
electronic voting record archive (Votul electronic) as a top-level nav item
session transcript archive (Stenogramele şedinţelor) alongside audio-video recordings
declarations-of-wealth/interest disclosure section (Declaraţii de avere şi interese) as mandated transparency feature
sitemap link labeled 'Hartă site' in the footer, a holdover from 2000s-era portal conventions

bodies.name: Guvernul României (Government of Romania / PM Office)
bodies.layout: An early-2010s-era XHTML Transitional site (visible in its DOCTYPE) built on a fixed 960px-wide layout with a repeating textured background image behind a centered white content well. The header holds a small PM/Government logo top-left, a RO/EN language toggle, a site-search flyout, and a dark-blue dropdown mega-menu (Prim-ministru, Guvern, Obiective, Media, Contact) with rich preview panels showing a photo and description per section. The homepage body runs a three-column 'teme' (themes) box grid and an 'actualitate' (current affairs) news grid, each capped at exactly 32.3% width with hard-coded pixel borders, styled in the site's signature red section-labels over blue headline links. The footer is a tall dark band with white link columns, a Facebook icon, and copyright text, sitting beneath a thin yellow-on-hover menu accent carried through from the main nav.
ui_patterns: dropdown mega-menu panels with an embedded photo, description, and 'Află mai multe' CTA per top-level item
fixed 960px legacy layout with repeating background-image chrome (bgbody.jpg, bgwindex.jpg)
three-column 'teme'/'actualitate' news boxes hard-capped at 32.3% width with pixel-perfect borders
red all-caps section eyebrow labels (color #990000) above blue headline links
flowplayer-based embedded video player (legacy Flash/HTML5 hybrid, flowplayer-3.2.6)
RO/EU co-branding ribbon element (roue2019 logo strip) fixed above the main header
government-session communique archive (Comunicate şi acte şedinţă de guvern) as a dedicated Media sub-item
accessibility-era font-size toggle absent, but a distinct 480px/800px/980px responsive breakpoint CSS cascade

bodies.name: Direcția Națională Anticorupție (DNA — National Anticorruption Directorate)
bodies.layout: The site (pna.ro redirects permanently to www.dna.ro) runs on a Java Server Faces / PrimeFaces stack, exposing '.xhtml' view-state URLs and JSF ViewState hidden fields rather than a modern CMS. The header is dominated by a large serif Times New Roman institutional title 'DIRECȚIA NAȚIONALĂ ANTICORUPȚIE' beneath a thin Romanian tricolor stripe (blue/yellow/red bars) and the motto 'IMPARȚIALITATE·INTEGRITATE·EFICIENȚĂ' in tracked capitals. Below a rotating photo galleria of the headquarters building, the homepage splits into three 'section' columns — comunicate (press releases), condamnări definitive (final convictions), and evenimente (events) — each a chronological list of case-outcome headlines. A prominent teal-to-cyan gradient 'blue-band' banner runs the width of the page with a single stark call-to-action, 'Sesizați o faptă de corupție' (Report an act of corruption), and the footer repeats the full menu as plain pipe-separated text links.
ui_patterns: JSF/PrimeFaces server-rendered forms with ViewState tokens embedded in page markup
tricolor (blue/yellow/red) flag-stripe header band echoing the national flag directly below the masthead
prominent full-width gradient banner with a single anti-corruption reporting CTA ('Sesizați o faptă de corupție')
three-column chronological case-outcome feed segmented into comunicate / condamnări definitive / evenimente
case headlines phrased as institutional-role outcomes rather than named individuals (e.g. 'Condamnare primar comună pentru luare de mită')
accessibility font-size stepper (A- / (normal) / A+) built into the top utility bar
pipe-separated plain-text footer menu with no visual button styling
institutional motto rendered as a tracked-letter-spacing all-caps banner beneath the header crest
